purpose: Define BR204 FULL178 resume-first execution under the repository Research OS heavy-workflow contract: ACTIVE_AUTO pull-request lifecycle, before..head dedicated-runkey authorization, generation/armed semantic gating, exact source/main locks, Stage32 concurrency headroom, 250 b x d-band recovery slots, exact single-d restart quanta, cumulative rolled partial state after every completed d, paginated carry recovery, bounded storage, and fresh-audit-only execution.

audited_predecessor.scope: previous push-trigger cold doorstep; superseded because generation-1 execution exposed a Research OS resume defect: in-progress b x d-band work was not checkpointed below the outer unit

live_main_refresh.execution_freshness_rule: Heavy authorize must fetch origin/main and require repository_main_head=37bb811b95399d73cc46fe899badcfa8eb5fca7d plus MAIN-STATE blob 232732e29f72b55c34d540bf1c7cfcc4a626851c. Any later main movement fails closed and requires a new cold doorstep refresh before execution.

objective_semantics.per_unit_output: Each durable (b,d-band) subunit emits exact merged (s,B,capacity) bins for BR202 K8 and BR203 mu plus d-dependent L>8/K8-tail-slot counters. Static BC state/mass metadata are repeated per band, must agree byte-semantically within b, and are counted once per b by the aggregator.
objective_semantics.k8_tail_slot_semantics: For a compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels, parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 is the K8 relaxed slot containing exact level 8 plus all deeper-level mass evaluated at q8. Do not reinterpret the slot as only qBC levels >8.
objective_semantics.global_composition: validate exact coverage of the approved 250 (b,d-band) subunits; count static BC population once per b; union all d-dependent exact capacities across subunits; group bins by exact rational ratio s/B; then solve one descending exact-rational ratio-class LP against the retained envelope
objective_semantics.equal_ratio_rule: Forced tail selection is computed only after summing capacity and tail-slot capacity over every bin with the same exact Fraction(s,B), so attribution is representation/order independent.
objective_semantics.forbidden: sum or average per-b LP floors; order equal-ratio bins to manufacture tail activity; materialize raw 4.1M routing-state JSON; terminal-identity fallback

qbc_tail_certificate.per_subunit_commitment: SHA256 of the complete validated (b,d-band) stream, including b/d-band/source locks and TAIL fields
global_checks: approved d bands are pairwise disjoint and cover every admissible even d exactly once for each b
all repeated static state/mass/tail metadata agree across bands of the same b and are counted exactly once per b
L<=8 plus L>8 static base-state partition equals H96 compact-state census
mu tail-slot capacities are subsets of mu capacities and mu<=K8
global ratio-class forced-tail attribution is exact and order independent
qbc_tail_certificate.br205_gate_firewall: Heavy result may emit raw and stronger tail-activity candidates, but formal BR205 gate remains false until the heavy result is hostile-audited and separately promoted.

resume_contract.checkpoint_rule: Execute one admissible even d at a time. After each exact d completes and validates, refresh a cumulative rolled partial-band certificate on runner-local storage. Thus the local recovery payload always commits to every completed d in that outer band.
resume_contract.artifact_salvage_rule: The classify/finalize and artifact-upload steps are guarded by always(). On ordinary worker failure, soft deadline, or cancellation where the runner remains available for post-steps, they validate and upload the latest complete-band or rolled-partial checkpoint. The artifact is the cross-run durable recovery object; raw single-d files are not retained across runs.
resume_contract.soft_deadline_rule: Stop starting new d work after 13,500 seconds inside a 330-minute job, leaving a large upload/cleanup margin. Emit SOFT_DEADLINE and deliberately fail the outer job only after the rolled partial has been uploaded, forcing a recovery generation rather than a blind full-band rerun.
resume_contract.recovery_rule: Generation >=2 explicitly paginates every artifact page from the immediate previous recovery-eligible run, validates/re-emits complete outer units and rolled partial bands, records discovered artifact count separately from validated carry counts, then computes only missing d values.
resume_contract.reuse_rule: A complete outer unit is reused only after the existing exact aggregator validates it. A partial band is reused only after source locks, band identity, completed/missing-d coverage, lineage digest, TAIL/SUM invariants, and aggregate raw digest validate. Conflicting or non-lineage partials fail closed.
resume_contract.single_d_timeout_rule: If one exact d exceeds 3,600 seconds, emit SINGLE_D_TIMEOUT_REQUIRES_FINER_PARTITION. That run is not eligible for blind resume of the same topology; introduce a finer exact execution-only partition first.
resume_contract.cancellation_rule: Ordinary cancellation uses the always-path best-effort salvage of the latest runner-local rolled checkpoint. A catastrophic runner loss can make the current job's not-yet-uploaded local rollup unavailable; this cannot be recovered from a vanished host, but previously uploaded complete/partial recovery objects remain durable and must be reused. Do not claim otherwise.
resume_contract.pilot_rule: Both pilots use the identical single-d runner, after-each-d local rollup, finalizer, upload, and recovery semantics used by production units.
resume_contract.cleanup_rule: Delete superseded recovery artifacts only after complete-prefix, partial-bundle, and recovery-metadata re-emission succeeds. Cleanup failure is a hard stop before new heavy compute.
resume_contract.pagination_rule: 100 or more possible predecessor artifacts requires gh api --paginate plus artifact-id download. Never treat unseen artifacts as missing mathematics.

storage_contract.bin_stream_note: Each outer band occupies at most one cross-run recovery slot: either one complete-band gzip or one rolled-partial gzip plus small state JSON. Exact per-d files are runner-local and folded into the rolled partial before upload.
storage_contract.high_mass_scaleout_gate: Both representative pilots must run through the same exact-d checkpoint/rollup/finalizer path. Measure max(final-band gzip, rolled-partial recovery payload) and require each recovery slot <=900000 bytes before fan-out.
storage_contract.projection_rule: At most 250 recovery slots per generation, each <=900000 compressed bytes. At rollover allow one prior recovery union and one re-emitted/current recovery union plus 20 MiB: 2*250*900000 + 20 MiB <=500 MiB.
storage_contract.absolute_peak_rule: Each of the 250 outer bands occupies at most one <=900000-byte recovery slot, complete or partial. At generation rollover at most one prior recovery union and one re-emitted/current recovery union coexist, plus 20 MiB fixed overhead.
storage_contract.recovery_retention: All BR204 recovery artifacts use 1-day retention, but superseded prior recovery artifacts are actively deleted after successful prefix re-emission so repeated generations do not accumulate one-day copies.

trigger.commit_range_rule: github.event.before..github.event.pull_request.head.sha must be fetchable and the dedicated runkey must be the only changed path in the arm commit

authorization.overlap_rule: Each arm/resume runkey must record observed_other_stage32_heavy_concurrency_at_arm <= 10; 8 + observed_other <= 18. If overlap cannot be bounded, authorization is false.
authorization.initial_execution_rule: After fresh hostile-audit PASS on the rebuilt cold doorstep, one distinct runkey-only synchronize commit changes generation 0->1 and armed false->true, records the audited doorstep head/review and Stage32 overlap observation, and may authorize heavy.
authorization.recovery_execution_rule: A later runkey-only synchronize commit increments generation by exactly one, refreshes the overlap observation, and may resume only an immediate prior recovery-eligible BR204 run. SOFT_DEADLINE and ordinary interruption/cancellation may resume from validated complete/partial artifacts. SINGLE_D_TIMEOUT_REQUIRES_FINER_PARTITION or source/validation failure blocks blind resume.
authorization.cold_event_rule: opened, reopened, workflow/source/docs/controller/status synchronizations, or any synchronize event without a semantic runkey generation advance are cold and must emit authorized=false before heavy jobs.

required_checks: 250 complete outer-unit exact coverage/disjointness over approved b x d-band units
every admissible even d covered exactly once per b
after-each-d local rollup path replayed and validated
always-path finalizer can recover a complete or rolled-partial checkpoint when STATUS is absent
predecessor artifact enumeration is explicitly paginated and discovered count is recorded separately from validated carry counts
complete prefix plus rolled-partial bundle re-emits before new compute
both pilots measure complete-band/rolled-partial recovery slots below 900000 bytes
single-d timeout is a hard finer-partition gate, never a blind timeout extension
H96 refined-state census counted once per b
H96 BC assignment-mass conservation counted once per b
global mu LP <= global K8 LP
post_run_gates.br205_gate: Only after the heavy result establishes exact FULL178 L>8/tail-slot activity and, for the stronger diagnostic, positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity under the order-independent global LP; any formal BR205 authorization additionally requires hostile audit.
post_run_gates.main_credit: requires separate hostile audit and MAIN MIN/replacement consumption; never automatic

audit_hold.defect: Generation-1 used outer b x d-band durability only; hours spent inside an incomplete band could be discarded on timeout. Rebuild now refreshes a cumulative exact rollup after every completed d and uses an always-path finalizer/upload before recovery.
